description_en: Modifies the configuration of the Active Directory (AD) authentication server for a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 修改堡垒机实例的AD认证服务器的配置
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-ad-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server 192.168.XX.XX --port 389 --base-dn dc=test,dc=com --domain domain --account cn=Manager,dc=test,dc=com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceADAuthServer

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The address of the server
parameters.help_zh: 服务器的地址
parameters.name: server

parameters.help_en: The address of the standby server
parameters.help_zh: 备用服务器的地址
parameters.name: standby_server

parameters.help_en: The port used to access the server
parameters.help_zh: 访问服务器的端口
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether SSL is supported. Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持SSL。取值：

true：支持
false：不支持
parameters.name: is_ssl

parameters.help_en: The base distinguished name (Base DN)
parameters.help_zh: 基准域名（Base DN）
parameters.name: base_dn

parameters.help_en: The domain on the AD server
parameters.help_zh: AD服务器上的域
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The server account
parameters.help_zh: 服务器的账号
parameters.name: account

parameters.help_en: The password of the server account
parameters.help_zh: 服务器账号的密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for users
parameters.help_zh: 用户的筛选条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The server attribute name mapped to the username
parameters.help_zh: 用户名称对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: name_mapping

parameters.help_en: The server attribute name mapped to the user email address
parameters.help_zh: 用户邮箱对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: email_mapping

parameters.help_en: The server attribute name mapped to the user mobile phone number
parameters.help_zh: 用户手机号对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: mobile_mapping

parameters.help_en: The interval at which user snapshots are automatically synchronized. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0, and 4 to 168. A value of 0 indicates that automatic synchronization is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 自动同步用户快照的间隔时间，单位为小时。取值为0或4～168，0表示不自动同步
parameters.name: sync_interval

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize the display name. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates that the display name is synchronized, and a value of false indicates that the display name is not synchronized
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步显示名称。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步
parameters.name: is_sync_name_attr

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize the mobile phone number. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates that the mobile phone number is synchronized, and a value of false indicates that the mobile phone number is not synchronized
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步手机号。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步
parameters.name: is_sync_mobile_attr

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize the email address. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates that the email address is synchronized, and a value of false indicates that the email address is not synchronized
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步邮箱。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步
parameters.name: is_sync_email_attr

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize the organization to which the user belongs as a user group. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates that the organization is synchronized as a user group, and a value of false indicates that the organization is not synchronized as a user group
parameters.help_zh: 是否将用户所在组织同步为用户组。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步
parameters.name: is_sync_ou_as_user_group

parameters.help_en: The name of the AD authentication server
parameters.help_zh: AD认证服务器名称
parameters.name: server_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the AD authentication server is the default server. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates that the server is the default AD authentication server, and a value of false indicates that the server is not the default AD authentication server
parameters.help_zh: 是否为默认AD认证服务器。取值：true表示是，false表示否
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en: The UserSourceId
parameters.help_zh: The UserSourceId
parameters.name: user_source_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
